# Infinitum Corporation

> Technology and security consulting firm headquartered in Washington, DC (1629 K Street NW, Suite 300, Washington, DC 20006). Moscow is an operating location only. Open Mon–Fri 9 AM–9 PM. Phone 202-729-9509. Email info@theinfinitumcorporation.com. Founder and President: William Aaron Turner.

Services: cybersecurity consulting; network security and network defense; ethical hacking and vulnerability assessment; IT and security consulting; AI applications for security operations; strategic risk assessment; defense technology advisory.
